title: Signed handover tokens
interface: class HandoverTokens(secret, max_age_hours). issue(handover_id: int, email: str) -> str (URL-safe, itsdangerous.URLSafeTimedSerializer with salt 'handover'). verify(token, now_offset_seconds: int = 0) -> dict | None: returns {'handover_id': int, 'email': str} or None for a bad signature or when the token is older than max_age_hours (now_offset_seconds is added to the current time when checking age; use serializer.loads(token, max_age=...) and, for the offset, compare the timestamp from loads(..., return_timestamp=True) yourself). Lower-case the email.
